$comment: The podman run arguments of the imp-host container, one array per line of the unit, without the image. bun run render:deploy writes them into deploy/imp-host.service and bootstrap.sh's copy; deploy/nixos/config.nix and scripts/dev/dev.sh read this file. network is the container network imp-host runs on with IPv6 and its bridge, and addresses the pipeline that prints the host's own addresses for IMP_HOST_ADDRESSES: render:deploy writes both into the unit and deploy/lib/host-env.sh. privileges replaces --privileged (docs/architecture/host.md#privileges). Each probed entry's args go in only where its path exists on the host. A word $NAME (unbraced) in lines is zero or more words from the env file in the unit, and a module option in Nix. --hostname: restic's backup locks name the host (docs/architecture/storage/backups.md). -e IMP_HOST_ADDRESSES: the unit writes the host's own addresses at each start, beside the probed args; without it in the environment, the container takes the env file's.
addresses: ip -o addr show scope global | tr -s " " | cut -d " " -f 4 | paste -sd ,
